summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature without running any code, per instructions. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch, coords) pairs with coordinates computed from padded slices; set_rnd skips double-underscore attributes); monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter generator; GridPatchDataset reworked to take patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates, with worker split, per-patch transform, and NotImplementedError for missing len; math import replaced by numpy ceil; PatchDataset docstring float alias fixed); monai/data/__init__.py exports PatchIter; docs/source/data.rst gets a PatchIter autodoc entry; tests/test_grid_dataset.py added with test_shape, test_loading_array, and an extra test_missing_len. Caveats: nothing was run, so the pinned test values and the docstring example output are unverified. test_loading_array calls set_determinism(1234) in addition to setUp seeding, to satisfy both spec lines. Three over-120-character lines remain in get_valid_patch_size's pre-existing docstring, which I left alone. No commits were made.
